title: Journey
subtitle: Where your calling operation stands, and the highest-leverage thing to do next.

error.title: We could not load your journey right now
error.body: This is only the summary — your calls, contacts and campaigns are unaffected. Refresh in a moment, or jump straight into your work.

empty.title: Your journey starts with one conversation
empty.body: Get a number, add a few contacts and make your first call. Everything else on this page unlocks from there.

paused.title: The Journey is paused
paused.body: Your progress is safe and keeps being recorded. Rewards will be available again shortly.

current.heading: You are here
current.completeBody: Every stage is done. Your workspace is using Ringee about as fully as it gets — keep an eye on connect rates and cost from the dashboard.

capabilities.heading: What you are using
capabilities.hint: A capability counts once it has produced real results — not when it is switched on.

counts.heading: What counts
counts.body: Progress is measured from real activity in this workspace: calls that were answered and lasted long enough to be a conversation, integrations that actually moved data, and AI that produced a result you can act on.
counts.doesNotCount: Turning a setting on, connecting an account, or inviting someone does not count on its own.
counts.workspaceScope: The Journey belongs to the whole workspace, not to one person.

foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.promise: Get set up and have your first real conversation.
foundation.value: Everything else in Ringee builds on one working number and one answered call.

consistent_caller.name: Consistent Caller
consistent_caller.promise: Turn calling into a routine rather than a burst.
consistent_caller.value: Spreading calls across days and contacts is what makes outbound predictable instead of lucky.

connected_operator.name: Connected Operator
connected_operator.promise: Wire your calling into the rest of your stack.
connected_operator.value: When outcomes land in your CRM and calendar automatically, nothing falls through and you stop re-typing.

ai_closer.name: AI-Powered Closer
ai_closer.promise: Let AI read your calls and tell you what works.
ai_closer.value: Transcripts and analysis turn every call into practice for the next one.

agentic_operator.name: Agentic Operator
agentic_operator.promise: Hand the repetitive work to an agent.
agentic_operator.value: Agents queue the calls and file the outcomes, so your time goes to conversations only you can have.

workspace_ready.name: Workspace Ready
workspace_ready.value: One verified number and one answered call proves the whole setup end to end.

team_activated.name: Team Activated
team_activated.promise: Get more than one person genuinely calling.
team_activated.value: A team that calls together is where shared numbers, analytics and coaching start paying off.

campaign_operator.name: Campaign Operator
campaign_operator.promise: Run a real outbound campaign end to end.
campaign_operator.value: Campaigns turn ad-hoc dialing into a repeatable process with leads, attempts and outcomes you can measure.

connected_sales_operation.name: Connected Sales Operation
connected_sales_operation.promise: Make the data flow both ways.
connected_sales_operation.value: Once calls, meetings and CRM records stay in sync, your pipeline reflects reality without anyone maintaining it.

ai_sales_team.name: AI Sales Team
ai_sales_team.promise: Put AI to work across the whole team.
ai_sales_team.value: Objection patterns and follow-up recommendations are far more useful across a team than for one rep.

advanced_operation.name: Advanced Operation
advanced_operation.value: Sustained volume across several capabilities is what keeps answer rates and cost under control at scale.

requirement.dialable_number: Have a number or verified caller ID
